abstract: A 2.5-year-old girl with no known medical problems had a witnessed sudden collapse and died. At autopsy, a large tumor was found within the interventricular septum of the heart. The gross and microscopic findings of the tumor were typical for a benign teratoma. Only five other cases of benign teratomas of the heart were found in a review of the literature. Pertinent features of these tumors are discussed.
abstract_ja: 2歳半の女児が、既往歴のない状態で目撃された突然の虚脱ののち死亡した。剖検で、心室中隔内に大きな腫瘍が認められた。肉眼および顕微鏡所見は良性奇形腫に典型的であった。文献検索では、心臓の良性奇形腫の報告は他に5例のみであった。これらの腫瘍の関連する特徴について考察する。
